title: Movable-Element Multi-Functional RIS-Assisted Hybrid RSMA-NOMA: A Constrained Hybrid Reinforcement Learning Approach
abstract: arXiv:2610.34701v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In this work, we propose a movable-element (ME) multi-functional reconfigurable intelligent surface (MF-RIS) architecture, termed MM-RIS, which integrates element mobility with adaptive signal reflection, transmission, amplification, and energy harvesting (EH) to enhance communication flexibility and energy self-sustainability. A hybrid rate-splitting multiple access (RSMA) and non-orthogonal multiple access (NOMA) transmission scheme is further designed to improve spectral efficiency. We formulate an energy efficiency (EE) maximization problem by jointly optimizing transmit beamforming, power and rate allocation, MM-RIS configurations, panel deployment, and ME positions. To address the resulting non-convex mixed continuous-discrete optimization problem, we propose constrained hybrid deep reinforcement learning with federated transformer and parametrized sharing (CRAFTS). CRAFTS integrates multi-agent proximal policy optimization (MAPPO)

translated_title: 可动元素多功能可重构智能表面辅助的混合RSMA-NOMA系统：一种约束混合强化学习方法
translated_abstract: 本工作提出了一种可动元素（ME）多功能可重构智能表面（MF-RIS）架构，称为MM-RIS，该架构将元素可动性与自适应信号反射、透射、放大及能量收集（EH）相结合，以增强通信灵活性和能源自给能力。进一步设计了一种速率分割多址接入（RSMA）与非正交多址接入（NOMA）相结合的混合传输方案，以提升频谱效率。我们通过联合优化发射波束成形、功率与速率分配、MM-RIS配置、面板部署以及可动元素位置，构建了能效（EE）最大化问题。为求解由此产生的非凸混合连续-离散优化问题，我们提出了融合联邦Transformer与参数化共享的约束混合深度强化学习方法（CRAFTS）。CRAFTS集成了多智能体近端策略优化（MAPPO）……
tldr: 提出了一种集元素可动、反射、透射、放大与能量收集于一体的MM-RIS架构，结合混合RSMA-NOMA传输方案，并利用约束混合深度强化学习算法CRAFTS联合优化各变量以实现能效最大化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a movable-element multi-functional RIS (MM-RIS) architecture combined with a hybrid RSMA-NOMA scheme, and develops a constrained hybrid deep reinforcement learning algorithm (CRAFTS) to jointly optimize system variables for energy efficiency maximization.
